newsitem.title: USA: Bacou sees Q3 $500,000 after-tax charge.
newsitem.headline: Bacou sees Q3 $500,000 after-tax charge.

text.p: Bacou USA Inc said Thursday it was going to take in the third quarter the last of a series of charges related to its acquisition of a manufacturer of respiratory protection products.
Bacou said in a statement that the charge for its May 30 acquisition of Survivair Inc would amount to about $800,000 or $500,000 net of tax.
For the second quarter, it reported a profit of $0.24 per share after a charge of $0.10 per share related to the deal, compared to a profit of $0.33 for the same quarter last year.
Bacou manufactures personal protection equipment, including safety eyewear and respirators.
